**Personalised Transition and Resilience Kit - Supporting University Students in their Transition to Campus Life**

This Kit explores key aspects of student resilience, from maintaining emotional stability to
developing strong support networks helping you create a foundation for thriving during your university journey.


Access a Ready to Read online version of the Kit [here](https://github.com/LuciaNico/bipolarvirtual/blob/main/Pamphlet_to_read_online.pdf).

Access a Ready to Print version of the Kit [here](https://github.com/LuciaNico/bipolarvirtual/blob/main/Pamphlet_ready_to_print.pdf).
